<thought>Based on the notes, subnetwork 1 consists of two resistors in series between terminals A and X1, with one resistor twice the value of the other. Let the smaller resistor be R1 and the larger be R2 = 2·R1. The measured total resistance A‑X1 is 6.667 Ω, so 3·R1 = 6.667 Ω → R1 ≈ 2.222 Ω and R2 ≈ 4.444 Ω. The topology therefore is A —R1— N1 —R2— X1.</thought>
<final_answer>{"resistors": {"R1": 2.222, "R2": 4.444}, "connections": [["A","N1","R1"], ["N1","X1","R2"]]}</final_answer>
